articles.title: More Americans believe the government is withholding information about UFOs
articles.summary: The truth may be out there, but Americans are split on what the truth is: just under half of people believe all sightings of unidentified flying object (UFO), also known as unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP), can be explained by human activity or natural phenomena, a new Gallup poll finds. The proportion of skeptics has been dropping, however: In 2019, 60 percent of Americans said they believed UAP were either human-caused or natural phenomena. That’s not to say that all those with shifting opinions are sure our planet has been visited by intelligent life from other planets: 37 percent of the poll’s respondents said some UAP were likely alien spacecraft, down from 41 percent in 2021.

articles.title: Exeter UFO Festival 2026: Your complete guide to out-of-this-world speakers and events
articles.summary: Exeter UFO Festival 2026: Your complete guide to out-of-this-world speakers and events - The Exeter UFO Festival is a Labor Day weekend tradition celebrating the 1965 "Incident at Exeter. " - Hosted by the Exeter-Area Kiwanis Club, the two-day event features UFO expert talks, a parade, and an alien costume contest. - Activities include trolley rides to the 1965 sighting location and continuous showings of historical videos. - Proceeds from the festival and a special police patch sale support local children's charities and scholarships. If you’ve walked through downtown Exeter lately, you may have spotted neon‑green alien faces peering from storefronts and posters — a sure sign that the UFO Festival is about to return.

articles.title: Here are some UFO reports from New Jersey residents in the past two months
articles.summary: More New Jersey UFO reports keep pouring in When New Jersey residents look up to the skies over the Garden State, some of them are seeing more than birds, planes, and SpaceX launches. Not every light or shape in the New Jersey sky is a UFO, or as they are known these days, UAP, but some of the things we are seeing are not easily explained. There is a website that keeps track of reported sightings, and it's called the National UFO Reporting Center. I took a look at the reports in New Jersey recently, and some of them sent a chill up my spine. Reports Of UFO Sightings In New Jersey Here's a report of a sighting over Ewing at 10:59 PM on August 15 of this year, Mist/ fog in sky with big light in front.
